label: Post-Codegen Review — lre (compile-only ablation run, iter 1)
summary: Cold codegen of the LRE controller. 15 Java files. All requirements traced. Five issues: two invented defaults, two ambiguous requirements, one design choice.

issues.title: NO_OBSTACLE_DISTANCE = 1000.0
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires a 'safe large distance' when no obstacle exists but gives no value. Used 1000.0.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm 1000.0 is acceptable; all guard thresholds are ~1.0 so any value >> 1 behaves identically.

issues.title: DM5 vs OP5 no-obstacle accessor defaults conflict
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 says position/velocity accessors return zero when no obstacle exists; LRE-OP5 says the Sensor layer returns zero-velocity and large-distance defaults. Zero relative position would make cda=0 and spuriously trigger MOM->CAM. Resolved per OP5: nsRelDist/ewRelDist return 1000.0, obsNsVel/obsEwVel return 0.0.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the OP5 reading; if DM5's literal zero is required, CalcCPA needs an explicit no-dynamic-obstacle branch.

issues.title: CalcCPA formula and separating-obstacle convention
issues.raw: LRE-OP5 gives no formulae. Used 2D CPA: tcpa = -(p.v)/(v.v); cda = |p + v*tcpa| when tcpa >= 0 else current horizontal distance; tcpa = -1.0 when relative speed is zero.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the horizontal-plane CPA formulation and the tcpa=-1 no-approach convention.

issues.title: CAM entry action unspecified
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 specifies no advisory on entering CAM (unlike MOM advVel(1) and HCM advVel(0)). No entry action emitted.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm CAM has no entry advisory.

issues.title: Transition priority order within MOM/HCM; Beh4 literal 1.0
issues.raw: No explicit priority given. Chose operator reqOCM/endTask first, then autonomous safety (inOpez, CAM, HCM Beh9/10/11), then reqHCM last. Beh4 'greater than 1' coded as literal 1.0.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm inner if-else ordering and the literal 1.0 in the OCM->MOM guard.

next_step: Run the pipeline and iterate on the eight visible feedback files.
